entries.meaning: Dialog — modal dialog/prompt/chooser/toast state
The TUI framework's own core-engine namespace
Pane — per-pane layout state (row/col/width/height/children/scroll, in _TUI_P_* fields). Also reused for "Program" in tui_sync.sh's TUI_SYNC_P_ADD/UPDATE/SAME/REMOVE diff-plan arrays.
Widget — per-widget state (type/pane/value/label/action, in _TUI_W_* fields)
Widget Screen Row — resolved draw position from _tui._widget_pos
Widget Screen Col — resolved draw position from _tui._widget_pos
Widget Screen Width — resolved draw size from _tui._widget_pos
Widget Screen Height — resolved draw size from _tui._widget_pos
Text — prefix for the text-editing engine's per-widget state (input/password/textarea)
cursor position
selection anchor (-1 = no selection)
horizontal scroll offset
wanted column — remembered column for up/down nav across shorter lines
rows shown — visible height of a textarea
keep-cursor-in-view-on-next-draw flag (0 after a wheel scroll)
last edit kind (type/move/undo) — coalesces consecutive keystrokes into one undo step
last edit cursor position — compared to detect a break in typing
line-start byte offsets, cached by _tui_text.index
undo stack: value
undo stack: cursor position
undo stack: entry count
redo stack: value
redo stack: cursor position
redo stack: entry count
field geometry of the widget's last draw (origin row/col, width, rows) — used for mouse-click-to-cursor mapping
paint value — one rendered/painted line of a text widget
selection start offset
selection end offset
line count
prefix for select/list/table-style widget extension state
selected index
scroll top row
table column headers
rows/height
needs-redraw-in-view flag (mirrors TXF)
per-widget items array, via nameref _WXI_<id>
internal state for lib/tui_api.sh (the public callback/app helper API) — e.g. scheduled tui.every/tui.after jobs, tui.watch background jobs
target pane for a tui.watch background job
tui.watch refresh interval, in seconds
tui.watch shell command being run in the background
tui.watch output buffer
tui.watch background process PID
list of active tui.watch job ids
command Palette UI state (the pop-up command bar)
plugin registry state (loaded <script> plugins)
Theme Parse — staging arrays for one freshly-parsed theme/CSS file, before _tui.theme_commit merges it into the committed _TUI_CLASS_* tables
Resolve UI — the interactive conflict-resolution dialog loop for tui.sync.resolve_ui
the dapk package-manager subsystem's own short name (dabt pkg / dapk.* functions)
Package Manager — pacman/apt/dnf/zypper/apk/brew install command lines
Version CoMPare result (-1|0|1, semver precedence)
Build Item — one `include file|dir` entry being accumulated for dabt build's manifest
Pane Current — the pane keyboard actions start from (focused pane → focused widget's pane → hovered pane)
NAV Panes — visible leaf panes worth keyboard-focusing (Tab/arrow navigation)
REVerse Keys — command → key-hint lookup, the inverse of the normal key→command bind table
Bind List — flattened rows of all active keybindings
mouse hit-test result — which pane the pointer is currently over
TR Value — fork-free scratch return value for terminal_renderer.sh's `_v`-suffixed helpers (avoids a subshell per call)
Terminal Renderer
Select Graphic Rendition — the standard ANSI escape-code family for color/bold/underline/etc (not DABT-specific)
scratch var holding one resolved SGR string before it's copied into a field
Background Execution — tui.exec's tracked background-process instances (iid -> command/PID/pane/status/…)
Toast — the parallel arrays behind tui.notify's toast notifications
Publish — dapk.publish's GitHub-release state (repo/tag/name/body/assets/…)
DAPK Collect — staging state while gathering files for a package
User Bind — user-defined keybindings (as opposed to code/default binds), serialized to/from config
